offers.sn: WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, not just juice, sandwiches, coffee, and much more.
offers.rq: Your main responsibility is to maintain operational excellence by observing, delegating, and executing daily concept workflow (DCWF), and hereby deliver a high degree of guest satisfaction, leading to financial performance.

offers.sn: In a Nutshell Every day we collect thousands of groceries for our customers in the Fulfilment Centers (FCs). The collected groceries are sent to our Hubs. Sometimes more than 250 people are working in one FC.
offers.rq: HBO (Bachelors) degree related to Supply Chain, Logistics/Fulfillment or Hotel- and Event Management; 1 to 6 years of relevant experience, for example as a Team Lead; You’re a quick thinker and can analyze a problem in no-time; Fluency in English, and preferably also Dutch
